model_output:
```sql
WITH fairmont_city AS (
  SELECT region_name, geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Fairmont City%' AND border_type = 'city'
),
nature_reserves AS (
  SELECT park_name, geometry
  FROM parks
  WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM fairmont_city))
),
max_reserve AS (
  SELECT park_name, geometry
  FROM nature_reserves
  ORDER BY ST_Area(geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM max_reserve), true) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM max_reserve))
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT park_name FROM max_reserve) AS reserve_name,
  MAX((ST_Value(rast, 1))::numeric) AS max_elevation
FROM clipped_dem;
```
